name: Fever
description: Body temperature above 100.4°F (38°C). Can be caused by infections, heat exhaustion, or inflammation.

name: Cough
description: A reflex action to clear the airways of mucus, smoke, or irritants.

name: Diabetes Type 2
description: A chronic condition that affects the way the body processes blood sugar (glucose).

name: Hypertension
description: A condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high.

name: Fasting Blood Sugar
description: Measures blood sugar levels after fasting for at least 8 hours.

name: ECG
description: Electrocardiogram measures the electrical activity of the heart.

name: Metformin
description: Medication used to treat Type 2 Diabetes by lowering blood sugar levels.

name: Amlodipine
description: Calcium channel blocker used to treat high blood pressure.

name: Lifestyle Modification
description: Includes regular exercise, healthy diet, and stress management.

name: Insulin Therapy
description: Used to regulate blood sugar levels in diabetes patients.

name: Hypertension Management
description: Reduce salt intake, increase physical activity, and take prescribed medications.

name: Diabetes Care
description: Monitor blood sugar regularly, maintain a balanced diet, and exercise.

name: Shortness of Breath
description: Difficulty breathing or feeling suffocated.

name: Chest Pain
description: Pain or discomfort in the chest, which may indicate heart-related issues.

name: Asthma
description: A condition in which your airways narrow and swell and may produce extra mucus.

name: Chronic Kidney Disease
description: A long-term condition where the kidneys do not work effectively.

name: Lipid Profile
description: Measures cholesterol and triglyceride levels in the blood.

name: Creatinine Test
description: Measures the level of creatinine in your blood to check kidney function.

name: Statins
description: Used to lower cholesterol levels and reduce the risk of heart disease.

name: Albuterol
description: Medication used to treat or prevent bronchospasm in asthma.

name: Physical Therapy
description: Helps improve mobility and reduce pain through exercise.

name: Dialysis
description: Artificial process of removing waste and excess fluid from the blood.

name: COPD Management
description: Stop smoking, use inhalers, and avoid lung irritants.

name: Fatigue
description: Extreme tiredness and lack of energy.

name: Weight Loss
description: Unintentional weight loss can be a sign of underlying health issues.

name: Obesity
description: Excess body fat that may impair health.

name: Liver Cirrhosis
description: Severe scarring of the liver caused by long-term damage.

name: Liver Function Test
description: Measures enzymes and proteins produced by the liver.

name: Losartan
description: Used to treat high blood pressure and protect the kidneys.

name: Omeprazole
description: Reduces stomach acid production to treat ulcers and acid reflux.

name: Surgery
description: Medical procedure to treat injury, disease, or other health conditions.

name: Chemotherapy
description: Drug treatment that uses chemicals to kill cancer cells.

name: Cancer Management
description: Includes surgery, radiation, chemotherapy, and targeted therapy.

name: Diabetes Prevention
description: Maintain a healthy diet, exercise regularly, and monitor blood sugar.

name: Headache
description: Pain or discomfort in the head or upper neck.

name: Nausea
description: Feeling of sickness with an inclination to vomit.

name: Blurred Vision
description: Loss of sharpness of eyesight.

name: Anemia
description: Lack of enough healthy red blood cells to carry oxygen to tissues.

name: Stroke
description: Occurs when blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted or reduced.

name: Stroke Management
description: Emergency medical care, blood thinners, and physical therapy.
